name: Sci-Futa
source:
Following a bad breakup, a very pent-up futanari goes to a space brothel to relieve her massive loads into some cheap prostitutes.

Perhaps she'll be able to relieve some of her stress along the way as well.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3450810/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
经历了一次糟糕的分手后，一个郁郁寡欢的扶他去一家太空妓院，通过一些廉价妓女来缓解她的大量负担。

也许她也能缓解一些一路上的压力。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/3450810/]Steam[/url]]
